accountId.title: Account Id
accountId.description: Id of the updated Account, if exactly one matched.

message.title: Message
message.description: Result to relay to the user: what changed, what is waiting for approval, or why nothing changed.

pendingApproval.title: Pending Approval
pendingApproval.description: True if a change was sent to the user's manager for approval and is not applied yet.

success.title: Success
success.description: True if the changes were made or sent for approval.
